description: Free-text concept resolution - find entities matching a free-text query. Prefers a candidate whose name/symbol exactly matches the query (case-insensitive), ranks those exact matches first across entity types, and demotes numbered susceptibility-locus labels (e.g. "lung cancer susceptibility 1") within each backend's candidates; each result's matched_on field reports why it was picked ("exact" or "first")
name: discover
